tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: During assessment proceedings, major issues relating to disallowances /additions since AY 1994 – 95 to AY 2003-04 on account of taxability of amount of advance license benefit receivable and passbook benefit receivable, deduction in respect of premium paid for lease hold land, data access fees paid, benefit claimed u/s. 80HHC / 80IA / 80IB and other miscellaneous addition /disallowances vide various orders. : The amount involved in various assessment orders is Rs. 18.30 Crores . The Company and Income-tax department has contested the above issues before High Court of Bombay and Income Tax Appellate Tribunal and same are pending for disposal. The management of Company believes that it has strong grounds to succeed in the matter.
tax_litigation.status: The matters pending before the ITAT has been disposed-off wherein the Tribunal have set-aside deduction allowable under Chapter-VIA (i.e. 80HHC / 80IA / 80IB) to the Assessing Officer for fresh computation. We are in process of evaluating future course of action. Also, we are following-up with the Assessing Officer for order giving effect for the tax impact of the said order. Further, AY 1993-94 & AY 1997-98 is pending before the High Court for certain additions / disallowance made in the assessment proceedings.
